title: Prove exact native ADD countdown backing and callback release condition
body:
## Summary

PR2902 leaves native ADD's non-payload backing separate. This package proves the exact `Counter.tape` peak in unchanged PR2697, including cleared buffers and old/new constructor overlap:

```text
C = p+r+m+max(m,r+(2s if S>1 else 0))
callback Counter cohort <= max(C,H), with complete release before return
```

The proof defines each encoded width and the no-capture ownership premise. A successful native callback that clears and retains two 32-cell tapes reaches 82 cells, refuting the 64-cell phase bound without release. This is one private-storage component, not total A, physical reserve, supplier admission or a new kappa.

Start with `research/selected-add-counter-backing/README.md` and `PROOF.md`. Exact source exports, license/notices, scope metadata and receipts are included. Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml PR2697, kumagi PR2882, Ross Richardson PR2874, and the retained lineage; PR2902 retains the payload result. Substantial AI assistance was used, including a separate derivation/review; no independent human review is claimed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR2902's released handoff leaves Counter backing unbound; clearing alone cannot justify release.
- **After:** 63 source-authenticated native fixtures, a separate 162-case write-observed census, nine embedded controls and five tests pass. Every primary endpoint matches an independent integer-address permutation, including the callback counterexample.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay passes: `python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-add-counter-backing`.
- Relocated Git-free, read-only-file CPython 3.14.8 replay passes with `-I -O -Werror -B`; all 18 files remain byte-identical. Exact committed-byte preflight passes at `119f74dfe6ff97d8d692a32ed02d6597220dd479`. Hosted CI is separate.
- Started at canonical main `b2024b853`; refreshed to `43381d62c` before submission. Priority revision 5, selected record and relevant guidance are unchanged. Complete overlap scan covers 487 open PRs, 2,112 closed PRs and 1,577 Discussion records, with no warnings. These snapshots exclude arbitrary diffs and unpublished work.

[Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18968627). Remaining work is the simultaneous Natural/numerical/callback-record backing ledger and physical placement/reuse. No full selected GL64 execution, frontier cold replay or exception-cleanup proof is claimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

An isolated opt-in package. Frozen predecessors and the selected frontier are unchanged.
